{{Quote|I guard the Proving Grounds. The trials lie beyond.|Garel-Mo|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Garel-Mo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] member of the [[Voss commandos]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was posted at the [[Shrine of Healing]], guarding the shrine's grounds where the [[Voss Mystics]] went to undergo their trials.<ref name="TOR" />
